notes:
High-level: Strong technical buy-in from ML infra and personalization team; weak Exec sponsor.

Context: Northbridge Retail Labs piloted a personalization + search POC with Redwood in Oct/Nov 2024. Initial champion was Head of AI (Marc Diaz) who pushed for Dedicated pool and VPC. Marc left the company unexpectedly during Nov reorg (accepted role at competitor). After Marc left the new org owner for 'AI Platform' consolidated several projects and deprioritized vendor spend; procurement put a temporary hold.

Quote from initial champion (Slack snippet): "If we can get steady latency under 120ms and cost < $0.0008/token after batching, we can justify Dedicated. I'll push this to exec." — Marc D. (now left).

What happened:
- 2024-10-14: Intro demo with AE/SE (Aisha/Marco). Good flow, prioritized latency.
- 2024-10-28: POC kickoff — integration to personalization pipeline, AAA experiment using embeddings for candidate reranking.
- 2024-11-02: Technical deep-dive with infra team (Fireflies ff_20241102_nb-retail-poc-call). SE recommended KV cache + prefix caching; showed expected cost curve.
- 2024-11-18: Marc informs AE that exec sponsor confirmed, asked for Dedicated sizing.
- 2024-11-29: Marc resigns; internal note: reorg announced (AI platform -> Shared Services).
- 2024-12-05: Procurement emails to AE: "hold until Q2 2025 budget cycle; security review paused." (thread-fx9271-northbridge-poc).
- 2025-01-15: Follow-up outreach; unresponsive. Legal flagged need for ISO/27001 evidence and stronger data residency guarantees. Ticket SEC-4510 opened.

Current state: Stalled. No engaged sponsor. ML engineering likes Redwood latency/cost profile but platform owner is consolidating vendors and will only prioritize consolidation vs existing cloud contracts. The team is evaluating an internal build and also got a quote from OpenAI managed endpoints for quick integration; procurement favors fewer vendors.

Technical notes/requirements captured:
- Target p95 latency target: <= 150ms for 32-token responses in retail ranking flow.
- Throughput burst: 150 concurrent requests across personalization service.
- Model preference: open model variants with high-quality embeddings; willing to test multiple quantized variants.
- Must support VPC peering, SSO (SAML), KMS integration, and per-route audit logs.

Sales notes / playbook:
- Primary blocker is organizational (no champion) + budget freeze. Low probability to close before Q3 2025 unless new sponsor surfaces or a competitor misstep.
- Suggested next steps: 1) Send short security FAQ & SOC2 + KMS architecture diagram to procurement (done). 2) Reach out to previous exec sponsor's manager for an intro to new platform head (pending). 3) Plan a low-touch quarterly check-in cadence (email every 8 weeks).

Next planned outreach: Tentative re-engage in 2025-04. If they open, aim to secure a quick pilot focused on embeddings-only (lower cost) to reestablish momentum.

Internal commentary: Favorite parts of POC: cache recommendations reduced latency in CI runs by ~22% in our sim. Procurement leaning to "one vendor" strategy — our risk. Lost-chance: medium unless we unearth new sponsor.
deal_status_notes: Stalled due to org churn; primary champion exited in Nov 2024. Procurement paused; competing vendor (OpenAI managed endpoints) under consideration. Re-engage in Q2 2025.
